# J.S. Warden

> Dark LitRPG and fantasy noir by J.S. Warden — books, in-world field dispatches, character profiles, and free browser tabletop tools.

## About & Authority

- **Author:** J.S. Warden is the fiction pen name of Josh, creator of **Built by Josh Studio LLC** (`https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt`).
- **Verified Profiles:**
  - Studio About: https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/about.html
  - Amazon Author Page: https://www.amazon.com/stores/author/B0FPQ3RWWF
  - YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@TalesofInkShadowsStudio
  - Contact: `support@builtbyjoshstudio.com`
- **Privacy & Browser Architecture:** Every tabletop tool under https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/ is free, ad-free, requires no signup, runs completely client-side in HTML/CSS/vanilla JS, and stores state only in browser `localStorage` on the user's device. Nothing entered is uploaded to any server. Privacy Policy canonical: `https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/privacy.html` (local mirror at https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/privacy/).

## Main pages

- [J.S. Warden — Dark LitRPG & Fantasy Noir](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/): Dark LitRPG and fantasy noir by J.S. Warden — explore Overlayed Echoes, Ebonspire Chronicles, field dispatches, and free browser tabletop tools.
  - Summary: Home hub for both fiction series, recovered in-world field dispatches, character profiles, and the free browser tabletop tool suite.
- [Books by J.S. Warden — LitRPG & Dark Fantasy Noir](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/books/): Books by J.S. Warden: Overlayed Echoes (dark LitRPG) and Ebonspire Chronicles (dark fantasy noir) — on Kindle Unlimited, with free Chapter One samples.
  - Summary: Full catalog page with verified edition details, ISBNs, free Chapter One sample links, book trailer, and series FAQ. *Overlayed Echoes* and *Ebonspire Chronicles* are completely separate worlds with no shared characters or storylines.
- [Free Tabletop RPG Tools · J.S. Warden](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/): Free, ad-free tabletop tools — trackers, rollers, a campaign journal, and generators for names, NPCs, taverns, hooks, and loot. No signup, in-browser.
  - Summary: System-agnostic tabletop suite grouped into Run the Table utilities and mid-session Generators. Runs locally and works offline once cached by the service worker.
- [Field Dispatches — Overlayed Echoes by J.S. Warden](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/writing/): In-world field dispatches from Overlayed Echoes by J.S. Warden — recovered logs from five friends before, during, and after the first session.
  - Summary: Sixteen canon companion logs set in 2045 across four chronological arcs.
- [Overlayed Echoes Characters — The Five Friends | J.S. Warden](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/writing/characters/): Meet the five friends of Overlayed Echoes — Kael, Theo, Angela, Marcus, and Lena. Spoiler-light character profiles from J.S. Warden's LitRPG.
  - Summary: Cast index with spoiler-light profiles and both studio and in-game portraits.

- **Free Chapter One Sample:** [Overlayed Echoes — Free Sample (Ch. 1) | LitRPG Novel](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/books/overlayed-echoes-preview/) (`Chapter One: The Setup`, downloadable PDF sample included, no signup required)
- **Official Book Trailer:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eYsgdcggow0 (`PT52S`)
- **Note on Audiobook:** An audiobook of the original shorter edition exists on Amazon; the current edition is an expanded full-length novel, and an expanded-edition audiobook has not been decided yet.

### 2. Ebonspire Chronicles (Book 1)
- **Genres:** Dark Fantasy, Noir Detective Fiction, Urban Fantasy
- **Published:** 2026-07-10 | **Length:** 294 pages | **Kindle Unlimited:** Free to read on KU
- **Formats & Verified Identifiers:**

- **Free Chapter One Sample:** [Ebonspire Chronicles — Free Ch. 1 Sample | Dark Fantasy Noir](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/books/ebonspire-chronicles-preview/) (`Chapter One: Blood in the Rain`, downloadable PDF sample included, no signup required)
- **Series Continuity:** Standalone dark fantasy noir setting in Ebonspire, a vertical city carved into a dead volcano; separate universe from *Overlayed Echoes*.

## Overlayed Echoes Characters

- [Kael](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/writing/characters/kael.html): **Role:** Game Master | **In-Game Persona:** The Wanderer | **Ties:** Lena's brother (legally and in spirit); lifelong friend of Theo, Angela, and Marcus.
- [Theo](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/writing/characters/theo.html): **Role:** Guardian | **In-Game Persona:** Sir Theron (Holy Warrior) | **Ties:** Angela's brother; the protector who counts the exits before anyone steps inside.
- [Angela](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/writing/characters/angela.html): **Role:** Healer | **In-Game Persona:** Sister Althea (Healer) | **Ties:** Theo's sister; nurse who settles a room with a checklist.
- [Marcus](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/writing/characters/marcus.html): **Role:** Trickster | **In-Game Persona:** Varkis (Trickster) | **Ties:** Lifelong friend; jokes as armor so nobody asks the next question.
- [Lena](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/writing/characters/lena.html): **Role:** Mage | **In-Game Persona:** Elyra (Mage) | **Ties:** Kael's sister; quiet, watchful, all explosive magic.

## Tabletop tools (Exact Capabilities, Limits & Local Storage)

### Run the Table
- [Initiative Tracker | Free TTRPG Combat Tracker, Any System](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/initiative-tracker/)
  - Summary: Turn order, rounds, HP, and conditions on one screen for any tabletop RPG.
  - Verified capabilities: Up to 40 combatants; automatic duplicate numbering (e.g. Goblin, Goblin 2); decimal tie-breakers (`15.5` sorts above `15`); quick HP damage/heal controls with zero-HP dimming; up to 8 condition tags per combatant (presets or custom, max 24 chars); Next turn / Back controls with automatic round counter; auto-saves to browser `localStorage` (`tynkr-initiative-tracker-v1`).
- [Dice Roller | Free Online RPG Dice with Notation & History](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/dice-roller/)
  - Summary: Full tabletop notation dice roller with pool builder, presets, and roll breakdown history.
  - Verified capabilities: Dice `d4` through `d100`; notation `NdX`, `+/-` modifiers, mixed pools (up to 12 terms, 1–100 dice per term), keep highest (`kh`) and keep lowest (`kl`); one-tap Advantage (`2d20kh1`), Disadvantage (`2d20kl1`), and `4d6kh3`; cryptographically secure unbiased rolls via browser `crypto.getRandomValues` when available; stores last 20 rolls in browser `localStorage` (`tynkr-dice-roller-v1`).
- [Session Notes & NPC Log | Free TTRPG Campaign Journal](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/session-notes/)
  - Summary: Browser-local campaign journal with session entries, searchable NPC log, and loot ledger.
  - Verified capabilities: Up to 20 campaigns, 200 session entries per campaign (up to 20,000 chars each), 300 searchable NPCs, and 200 loot items with check-off state; one-click Markdown (`.md`) campaign export; full `.json` backup export and restore (up to 32 MB); receives NPCs directly from the NPC Generator via shared `localStorage` (`tynkr-session-notes-v1`).
- [Wargame Score Tracker | Free VP & CP Tracker, Any System](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/wargame-score-tracker/)
  - Summary: Shared two-player miniature wargame score sheet for any system.
  - Verified capabilities: Two editable player names; 3–6 configurable battle rounds (default 5); per-round primary victory points (`0–999`); up to 12 custom secondaries per player (`0–999` each); command point counters (`0–99`); live totals; auto-saves mid-game in browser `localStorage` (`tynkr-wargame-score-v1`).
- [Random Table Roller | Roll on Your Own Custom TTRPG Tables](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/random-table-roller/)
  - Summary: Custom rollable table builder and paste-to-roll library.
  - Verified capabilities: Up to 50 saved tables, 500 entries per table, max die face `d1000`; parses plain lines, numbered entries, weighted ranges (`01-05`), and percentile rules (`00` = `100`, `0` = `10`, zero-indexed auto-shift); single rolls and distinct no-repeat batches; `.txt` table export; stores 12-roll history and tables in browser `localStorage` (`tynkr-table-roller-v1`).

### Generators
- [Fantasy Character Name Generator | Free, Any Style](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/character-name-generator/)
  - Summary: Generates 6 original invented fantasy names per click in four styles: Flowing, Guttural, Short, or Noble. One-click copy and kept list of up to 30 names saved in browser `localStorage` (`tynkr-name-generator-kept-v1`).
- [NPC Generator | Name, Quirk, Motivation & Secret, Free](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/npc-generator/)
  - Summary: One-click playable NPC (name, occupation, quirk, motivation, secret). One-click copy, kept list of up to 20 NPCs saved in `localStorage` (`tynkr-npc-generator-kept-v1`), and one-tap "Add to Session Notes" integration (`tynkr-session-notes-v1`).
- [Tavern Generator | Name, Patrons, Rumor & Menu, Free](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/tavern-generator/)
  - Summary: One-click fantasy tavern (establishment name, atmosphere, patron, rumor, menu). System-agnostic; one-click copy and kept list of up to 20 taverns saved in `localStorage` (`tynkr-tavern-generator-kept-v1`).
- [Plot Hook Generator | One-Line Adventure Hooks with a Twist](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/plot-hook-generator/)
  - Summary: One-click adventure hook paired with a built-in twist. System-agnostic; one-click copy and kept list of up to 20 hooks saved in `localStorage` (`tynkr-plot-hook-kept-v1`).
- [Loot Generator | Flavorful Treasure Without the Stat Blocks](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/loot-generator/)
  - Summary: System-free treasure descriptions (object, odd detail, backstory/history). One-click copy and kept list of up to 20 entries saved in `localStorage` (`tynkr-loot-generator-kept-v1`).
